title: Bounded data refill
summary: Ask only explains refill. Switch to Plan to download, and always give an explicit start and end. Unbounded history is rejected.
narrative:
data.refill writes local tables over the network. Ask only explains that path. To actually download, switch to Plan. The planner requires start and end (YYYYMMDD or a year range). Missing dates become clarify_required / date_range, not an unbounded refill. This Ask answer has no plan_id.

A session can fill those dates on the next Plan turn without re-classifying the Job. Full-market refill without symbols is expensive; say so in assumptions. If a lookup returns an id but a read comes back empty, the usual cause is that the table or that date window was never downloaded — check the starter set and local overview before asking for another unbounded pull.
python_code:
from qteasy_ai.app import QteasyAssistant
assistant = QteasyAssistant()
print(assistant.plan('download A-share daily data to local datasource', response_style='raw')['plan']['steps'][0]['inputs']['fallback_action'])
risk_notes: Never run unbounded refill. Confirm before execute. allow_refill only gates agent_auto.
